summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Notion-style task manager. Backend APIs working well (15/16 tests passed), frontend fully functional with all core features working including dashboard, Kanban board, list view, task CRUD operations, search, filters, and category management.

minor_bugs.issue: Allows creating tasks with empty titles (should return 422 validation error but returns 200)
minor_bugs.impact: Users can create tasks without titles, which may cause UI/UX issues

passed_tests: Dashboard page loads with correct stats (Total Tasks, In Progress, Completed, Overdue)
Navigation between Dashboard, Kanban Board, and List View works perfectly
Task creation via 'New Task' button from all pages
Task editing by clicking on task cards
Task deletion using delete button in task modal
Kanban board displays tasks in correct columns (To Do, In Progress, Done)
List view displays all tasks with working filters (status, priority)
Search functionality in list view works correctly
Task completion toggle via checkbox works
All API endpoints working (categories CRUD, tasks CRUD, stats)
Error handling for non-existent resources (404 responses)
Task filtering by status and priority
Dashboard progress bar and stats display correctly
action_item_for_main_agent: Add validation to prevent creating tasks with empty titles in the backend API (should return 422 error for empty title field)
success_percentage: Backend: 94% (15/16 tests passed), Frontend: 100% (all core features working)
